== Summary ==
The Players Committee's Remaster sheet <code>VirtualCards10.pdf</code> for [[Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology]] (official text as of 4 December 2006; PDF made 19 March 2007). It has a cover, the set symbol and the Remaster slips. It is a later version than [[:File:Original Virtual Set 10 card slips.pdf]], which is the first sheet of the set with different text.

* '''Date:''' 19 March 2007 (PDF creation date)
* '''Pages:''' 2

== Source ==
[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards10.pdf VirtualCards10.pdf], Star Wars CCG Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193603/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards10.pdf Internet Archive]. The archived copy is byte-identical to this file (the SHA-1 of the archived payload matches).
